verdict.rationale: Secureframe ships generative AI features (Comply AI for policies, risk, and vendor reviews), so whether customer data is used to train AI models is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a training opt-out, a no-training commitment, or any related data-use control. The AI feature pages, MCP docs, and Trust Center visibility toggles do not address model training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
